test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 29th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Once and for all
solution:
The correct answer is **'finally'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given idiom 'once and for all' means** completely and finally__**.

 
 
• ***Example:** In life we have to make certain decisions **once and for all.***
 
 
 
• Therefore, the** marked option 2 **is the correct answer.
